answers.core: It about an existing core feature which usefulness is halved without this improvement.
answers.workaround: It's easy to write scripts that will allow this behavior while the project is running, but simple tool scripts don't work with inputs, and EditorPlugins are on a completely different level of complexity and challenge. The "Preview" property also does not seem to be exposed anywhere.
